protocol.beamformer: frozen v2 Hann60 / horizontal Gaussian / 8x; native 2.5cm, intensity 2x2 mean to 5cm
protocol.autofocus: top30 corrupted-image contrast candidates; separation 2m; no GT; 0.4m square, 5mm grid
protocol.phase_estimator: same fixed per-ping entropy setting selected on development points; no object-specific retuning
protocol.pooling: circular average adjacent-ping phase gradients, weighted by patch contribution energy; 3 fixed range bands [0,35,55,90.1]; integrate and remove constant/linear phase
protocol.detector: frozen official-SLC-trained RF and frozen validation threshold; no training on own BP
protocol.evaluation: whole valid image, point match radius1m, exact same mask as primary; no GT crops for detector or correction
protocol.status: single held-out scene controlled-error handoff diagnostic, not 4-scene generalization or primary adoption evidence
